dialogues.speaker: Rahetar
dialogues.text: You know what I mean... love and romance, fighting and death, especially those tall tales about the thief Reed Miller. It just leads them astray.

dialogues.speaker: Rahetar
dialogues.text: Luckily, my Kasha is a clever child. She'd never read any of that brain-rotting nonsense. But if other children were to read it, who knows how much damage it could do?
